name: EASE AI
full_name: EASE AI — AI workshops & learning by E.A.S.E.
summary: EASE AI runs live and in-person AI workshops for everyone — students, educators, professionals, creators. Cinematic, confident, slightly provocative: it names the gap between using AI and knowing what to do with it. Night-black and signal orange, editorial grotesk type, mono labels, real UI as proof.

colours.name: Signal Orange
colours.use: The accent: key headline line, FREE pill, CTA buttons, labels, highlights. Never a full background except a CTA.

colours.name: Night
colours.use: Cool near-black for dark cinematic posters

colours.name: Ember Black
colours.use: Warm near-black for dark editorial posters and info bars

colours.name: Cream
colours.use: Light posters' background; headline colour on dark (instead of pure white)

colours.name: Warm Grey
colours.use: Secondary text, de-emphasised list items ('the basic approach')

fonts: Display: 'Inter Tight' 800–900, ALL CAPS for headlines, tight tracking (-0.04em to -0.05em), leading 0.9–0.95. Labels: 'JetBrains Mono' 500–700, ALL CAPS, wide tracking (0.2–0.3em), 20–26px. Soft lead-in line: 'Instrument Serif' italic, large (64–110px). Body: 'Inter Tight' 500–600. CSS stacks: 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif / 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace / 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif.
hard_rules: Write the name as "EASE AI" (as on the logo). It is part of the E.A.S.E. family but has its own look — never use the E.A.S.E. Mental Math navy/teal or the GEC navy/gold here.

Recurring campaign system (keep it consistent across a campaign): logo top-left in its white rounded tile; top-right an orange 'FREE' pill + mono label such as 'LIVE AI WORKSHOP'; a bottom info band with the date and times in columns (big grotesk figure + small orange mono sub-label); an orange pill CTA 'REGISTER NOW →'.
Headlines: short, provocative, two-tone — cream (or ink on light) for the set-up, Signal Orange for the turn. A question or a 'gap' framing works well.

Imagery: cinematic photography graded to amber/orange and deep shadow — lone figures, screens, city light, data glow — or real-looking UI cards (browser, phone, agent checklist, workflow chips) as proof of what people can build. Generated people are anonymous, never presented as real attendees.
Times and dates must be exactly as supplied (workshops often list Melbourne, New Zealand and Bahrain times). Never invent venues, dates or prices.
Voice: direct, confident, inclusive ('for everyone — no matter your background'), never hype or fear-mongering beyond a gentle nudge. No 'unlock your potential'.
Logo: never stretch, recolour or redraw it; keep it on its white tile. (Current file is a placeholder cut from a poster — replace with the original in the Brand library.)

logos.note: EASE AI logo on its white tile (solid white background, aspect ~1.71:1). Placeholder cropped from a campaign poster — use at 170–240px wide, top-left, rounded corners via a wrapper with border-radius:18px and overflow:hidden.
